# E0310: a lens does not declare the instance it takes

A lens binds the instance it takes to a field named after the version it
maps from: v1_0 for a lens from 1.0. This lens does not declare it, so it has
nothing to map from.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
lin: {
	name: "ship"
	schemas: {
		"0": "0": {
			schema: {a: string}
		}
		"1": "0": {
			schema: {b: string}
		}
	}
	lenses: {
		"1.0->0.0": {
			v0_0: {a: "x"}
		}
		"0.0->1.0": {
			v0_0: _
			v1_0: {b: v0_0.a}
		}
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0310]: lens 1.0->0.0 does not declare v1_0, the instance of 1.0 it takes
  --> lineage.cue:12:3
   |
12 |         "1.0->0.0": {
   |         ^^^^^^^^^^
   |
   = help: write v1_0: _
```
